QF.id: AIFM CII Investment Process and Governance_32

question.text: Per the SEBI (AIF) 2025 amendment, a CIV scheme for co-investment:

answer.text: Can borrow funds up to 2x of its corpus
Can leverage up to 10% for temporary liquidity
SHALL NOT borrow funds directly or indirectly or engage in any kind of leverage

explanation.text: The Logic: The SEBI 2025 CIV framework explicitly prohibits CIV schemes from borrowing directly or indirectly or engaging in any kind of leverage. CIV schemes are 'clean' pass-through vehicles only. The Trap: 2x is the Cat III leverage cap — not applicable here. 10% temporary and derivative-hedging permissions are Cat III AIF rules for the main fund, not CIVs.
